item.title: Incarico post-doc: Identification of Allosteric Modulators of Hemoglobin to Regulate the Oxygenation State for Treatment of Sickle Cell Disease (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-09 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-07 Chimica farmaceutica, tossicologica, nutraceutico-alimentare, delle fermentazioni e dei prodotti per il benessere e per la salute

The research project focuses on the development of a computational model for the selection of novel hemoglobin allosteric modulators, employing virtual binding studies targeting the allosteric site. Selected compounds will be evaluated for their hemoglobin inhibitory activity. The most promising candidates will undergo optimization through further virtual screening and chemical synthesis. These novel molecules will be re-evaluated for their activity on hemoglobin, and subsequent lead compounds will be tested on erythrocytes obtained from patients with sickle cell anemia.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Pica Code IR-2026-109 Development of Advanced Life Cycle Assessment and Life Cycle Costing Models and Tools for the Environmental Characterization of Products, Processes, Services or Organizations (Univ. MODENA e R. E.)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-24 13:00
Institution: Univ. MODENA e R. E., Reggio Emilia
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-06 Fondamenti chimici delle tecnologie

The research activity will focus on the development of integrated Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) and Life Cycle Costing (LCC) models and tools to support decision-making for products, processes, services or organizations. It will address the definition and integration of environmental and economic variables, parameters, indicators, and life cycle inventories. Models will be developed for hotspot identification, trade-off assessment, and comparison of alternative life cycle scenarios, including sensitivity and uncertainty analyses. The resulting tools will support improvement strategies, management decisions, and environmental and economic performance assessment and reporting.

item.description:

Institution: Politecnico TORINO, Torino
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-06 Fondamenti chimici delle tecnologie

Within the European HIPERZAB project (GA 101115421), the research aims to develop biopolymer-based gel electrolytes for electrically rechargeable zinc-air batteries intended for stationary renewable energy storage over days or weeks. The focus will be on mildly acidic formulations and their integration into bilayer architectures with alkaline electrolytes. The objective is to correlate material composition, structure and properties to improve ionic conductivity, interfacial stability, water retention and operational lifetime. item.description:

Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-03 Chimica generale e inorganica

The research programme aims to develop catalytic systems based on non-noble metals for the selective semi-hydrogenation of acetylene to ethylene under visible light, using water as a proton source. Activities will focus on the design, synthesis and characterization of first-row transition-metal complexes and the evaluation of their activity in combination with photosensitizers. Relationships between complex structure, electrochemical properties and catalytic performance will be investigated to optimize efficiency,selectivity and stability. Spectroscopic, electrochemical and isotope-labelling studies will probe electron and proton transfer processes and the reaction mechanism. The findings…
